description: This file defines the RootView struct, which is a SwiftUI View managing user authentication and app lock states. It displays either a HomeView or LoginView based on session status, overlays an app lock interface when needed, and handles session restoration and app state changes.

classes.name: RootView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that manages authentication states, app lock overlay, and session persistence, providing the main view logic for the app.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The main view content that conditionally displays either the HomeView or LoginView, manages overlay presentation when app is locked, and handles app lifecycle events such as restoring sessions and locking when backgrounding.
